MODULE 03 · BEFORE PYTHON · THREE STUDENTS

Snake Trio Working Contract

Do not edit Python yet. Complete this contract together, confirm GitHub access, and make every decision visible to all three members.

1. Team identity and first roles

MEMBER 1Driver

Types only the agreed small change.

MEMBER 2Navigator

Reads the contract, predicts, and protects scope.

MEMBER 3Tester / Recorder

Runs tests and preserves evidence.

Team namePrivate GitHub repository
Communication channelNormal response time

2. Our explicit agreements

DecisionOur trio agreement
CommunicationWhere will we talk, and how quickly will we reply?
Role rotationRotate Driver, Navigator, Tester/Recorder after each completed TODO.
GitHub merge gateOne peer review + green public/student tests before merge.
DisagreementRestate the contract, write one test, compare evidence, then ask a TA.
Stop-and-askAsk after 15 focused minutes without a new observed fact; ask immediately for setup/access.
Absence or delayHow will we notify the trio and hand off unfinished work?
Individual proofEach member explains one contract, one test, and one GitHub decision.

3. AI L1 boundary

Allowed

Explanations, hints, counterexamples, test ideas, and help reading a traceback.

Not allowed

Final function bodies, silent copying, invented evidence, or impersonating a team member.
